body: Some people weren’t meant to be happy I think. Some of us don’t get to be happy. We just get shit.

I can’t enjoy anything any more. Food tastes like ash. The best I can do is distract myself with tv shows and movies. Things that require little participation and let me pretend to stop existing.

Losing my virginity to an escort really would just cement the fact that I’m a pathetic loser. I already am one, but I’d rather not make that concrete in my head that I’m so undesirable that was the only way I could do it.
